paper_title: Detecting Ultralight Bosonic Dark Matter via Absorption in Superconductors
notes: Projection paper for ultralight bosonic DM absorption in superconducting aluminum. Constrains three couplings: dark photon kinetic mixing (Fig.3), pseudoscalar g_aee (Fig.4, AxionElectron), and scalar d_phiee (Fig.5). Selected AxionElectron per hint and Eq.(21) electron coupling g_aee. Data points are rough estimates read from Fig.4 1-kg-year reach curve; no numerical table provided. Mass range 1 meV to 10 eV. Local DM density rho_X=0.3 GeV/cm^3 (Eq.3). 95% CL (3.6 events).
